text:
Dan Li: FYI customer acme-corp escalated — they claim missing audit events around 2026-10-03 13:00 UTC during a brief outage. I queried the audit_index and theres a gap in event counts for that tenant id.

Ben Patel: can you paste the query you ran?

Dan Li: sure. ran against elastic/audit_index:
```
GET /audit_index/_search
{
  "query": {
    "bool": {
      "filter": [
        {"term":{"tenant_id":"acme-corp"}},
        {"range":{"@timestamp":{"gte":"2026-10-03T12:50:00Z","lte":"2026-10-03T13:10:00Z"}}}
      ]
    }
  },
  "size": 0,
  "aggs": {"per_min":{"date_histogram":{"field":"@timestamp","fixed_interval":"1m"}}}
}
```
Results: 12 events before 13:00, 0 events from 13:00-13:05, then resumed.

Alice Chen: any chance this is sampling? we have tenant-level sampling and a config flag sample_rate that was toggled last week for experiments.

Dan Li: I checked tenant config: acme-corp had sample_rate: 0 (should be full) but the effective config at delivery-layer was 0.1 for that region due to an env inheritance bug.

AuditBot: Ingestion alert: kafka-to-es pipeline reported 1m consumer lag at 2026-10-03T13:02:17Z for partition audit-part-7 (pipeline-id: ingest-v2).

Ben Patel: ok two vectors: 1) sampling misapplied, 2) ingestion lag/window dropped events. If ingestion lag hit retention threshold, downstream bulk write might have skipped duplicates and left a gap. Need to correlate with raw S3 and KMS logs.

Cara Morales: customer is asking for proof of actions — they want a signed timeline showing who did what and whether their requests were processed. Theyll escalate to security compliance if we can't provide trace.

Dan Li: steps I propose:
- enable full sampling for acme-corp immediately (done).
- run backfill from raw kafka s3 topic for the 13:00-13:10 window (I can start).
- collect KMS request IDs for any decrypt calls that map to acme-corp requests and provide those to customer as nonce proof.

Alice Chen: how do we extract KMS decrypt correlation? we store kms_request_id in audit.metadata.kms_id for decrypt events but if events are missing we can still query KMS CloudTrail for principal "redwood-inference-rotate" or our KMS key id. KMS logs include ciphertext length and request id.

Ben Patel: add the following query to backfill script to map raw events -> audit schema, and dedupe by request_id:
```bash
python tools/backfill_audit.py --tenant acme-corp --start "2026-10-03T12:50:00Z" --end "2026-10-03T13:10:00Z" --output /tmp/acme-backfill.jsonl
# script will extract raw kafka messages from s3, transform to audit schema, annotate with kms_request_id and original_offset
```

Dan Li: started backfill job, tracking id backfill-1876543210. First stage (s3 extract) running. ETA ~8m.

AuditBot: Backfill job backfill-1876543210: extracted 1,203 raw messages, 210 matching tenant acme-corp.

Alice Chen: when you transform, make sure to set audit.event_version and include schema_migration_applied:true if we run any retro mappings. Customer-facing payload should include original_timestamp, ingester_offset, and kms_request_id for verification.

Cara Morales: that would be ideal. Customer legal will accept KMS request ids + raw timestamps. They specifically asked that we do not include internal IPs in the export. Need redaction on ip.* fields.

Dan Li: noted — backfill export will redact ip.* fields. We're mapping event fields to the public schema: ["@timestamp","actor.principal_id","action","resource","outcome","request_id","kms_request_id","ingester_offset","original_timestamp"].

Ben Patel: after backfill, run this sanity check to confirm no duplicates and monotonic timestamps:
```sql
SELECT request_id, count(*) FROM exported_acme_backfill GROUP BY request_id HAVING count(*) > 1;
```
If any duplicates exist compare ingester_offset and keep earliest.

AuditBot: KMS lookup: found decrypt actions with KMS request ids [k-req-9f7a, k-req-9f8b] in CloudTrail around 2026-10-03T13:01:52Z matching ciphertext sizes.

Dan Li: good — one of those maps to request_id r-10293 which Acme cited. I'm attaching a short timeline snippet for the customer export.

Ben Patel: also file a stability bug for env inheritance on sampling flags. This should never apply to enterprise tenants by default.

Alice Chen: created GH issue #repo/infra-ops 424: "tenant sampling env inheritance causing enterprise sampling". Assigning to eng-infra.

Cara Morales: customer update draft: "We performed a complete backfill and correlation with our KMS and raw logs. Attached are the reconstructed events for your review. We redacted network identifiers as requested. If you need signatures on KMS request ids we can provide signed CloudTrail excerpts."

Dan Li: backfill completed. 210 events reconstructed, 6 had partial schema mismatches and were normalized with migration v3 mappings. Export ready at s3://redwood-private-exports/acme/backfill-1876543210.jsonl (ACL: customer-download, expires 7d).

AuditBot: job backfill-1876543210: completed in 7m 12s.

Ben Patel: fine. Next actions: 1) confirm customer download + closure, 2) backfill verification doc posted to incident-runbook, 3) infra bug fix + deploy.

Cara Morales: I'll send the export and note the KMS request ids. Thanks everyone. :thumbsup:

Dan Li: closing thread, leaving notes in incident tracker INC-2026-887.
